title: Load, Capacity, and Headroom
summary: Compare synthetic power load with available capacity and state assumptions.
objectives: Explain headroom without treating an arbitrary percentage as law.

vocab.def: The power demand represented by equipment or services.
The available amount a system is designed to support in a scenario.
Unused capacity kept available for variation or safe planning.

sections.heading: Use units and assumptions
sections.body: If three modeled servers use 400 W each, the modeled load is 1,200 W. Compare it with stated capacity and document whether figures are estimated.

practice.prompt: A synthetic rack has 1,200 W load and 2,000 W capacity. What remains?
practice.answer: 800 W of modeled unused capacity, subject to the scenario assumptions.

quiz.question: Why document assumptions?
options: Other people can check the calculation
It proves a facility design is complete
quiz.answer: Other people can check the calculation

reflectionPrompt: What additional information would change your conclusion?
